correctness.rationale: Orthogonalizing A^-1v gives v2=(A^-1v-alpha v)/beta, hence A v2=(v-alpha Av)/beta and (I-P)A v2=-(alpha/beta)(I-P)Av exactly. Opposite-sign eigenweight construction with three distinct eigenvalues uses nonzero Vandermonde determinant, and necessity follows from the inverse Rayleigh quotient and Krylov minimal polynomial. Independent SymPy computation confirms determinant 36r^2, alpha=9(r^2-1)/(9+17r^2), exact gamma^2 rational expression, and endpoint constants. Continuity gives full range on 0<r<1; no approximate rounding premise.
